Title: LECA for Hydroponics: pH, Best Systems, Rinsing & Reuse
Description: LECA (expanded clay) is about pH 7.0, drains fast and lasts years: best for ebb and flow, Dutch buckets and aquaponics beds. How to use and reuse it. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic leca, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
